thread:
Maya: FYI — Zenith (enterprise) just confirmed a term sheet contingent on POC results and a capacity runbook. Need presales + ops checklist.
Lee: Thanks. Do we have their expected throughput profile? peak qps, burst, mix?
Maya: Sales said 120 steady qps daytime, bursts to ~300qps for <5m, ~2M tokens/day. 60% chat gen, 40% embeddings at 1:1 embed per chat request.
Sam: Ok. Embedding workloads are cheaper but concurrent CPU/GPU mix matters. For 300qps bursts we should plan for prefix caching + autoscale.
Priya: Security side — they require KMS integration, customer-managed keys, and SOC2 evidence. Also want VPC peering for the Private plan.
Alex: From product: recommend model variants — base gen for standard, quantized variant for reserve/burst to save costs. We'll need model pin for the commit.
Maya: Pricing question from Zenith: how many reserved GPUs to commit vs burst credits? They want a discount if they reserve >= 4 GPUs.
Lee: Quick calc: steady 120qps -> if 1 request = ~75 tokens avg, that's ~9k tokens/s ~= 777k tokens/min ~1.1B tokens/day? that seems off. can we sanity-check assumptions?
Sam: Let's use a simpler estimate: 120qps * 75 tokens = 9000 tokens/s -> 777600000 tokens/day (0.78B). Your 2M/day earlier must be their higher estimate; verify with sales.
Maya: Updated from sales: 2M is conversations/day, not tokens. apologies. So token estimate ~2M conv * 200 tokens/conv = 400M tokens/day.
Lee: Cool — so steady-state GPU footprint should be roughly X; practical mapping: 1 A100 (prod optimized) can handle ~90-150 qps for short context models with batching. For mixed chat+embed: plan reserved 2 GPUs min, allow burst to 6.
Sam: Recommend reserved pool = 3 GPUs with autoscale policy to +3 for 15m bursts. Set minHealthy=2 for fallbacks. Add queue depth throttle at 500ms tail to prevent latency SLO violation.
Priya: Onsecurity blockers: they want DPA + subprocessor list and confirmation that logs with PHI are not retained. Also need E2E encryption in transit and at rest (we have that). I'll start the questionnaire.
Alex: Ops note — KV cache warmup: preheat plan needs synthetic traffic to fill KV across all devices. Preheat job: run 50 concurrent sessions for 10 minutes per GPU.
Maya: Action items: 1) confirm tokens/conv with Zenith (Maya), 2) draft reserve vs burst pricing (Lee), 3) security questionnaire kickoff (Priya), 4) preheat smoke plan (Sam).
Lee: Pricing sketch: reserved 3 GPUs monthly + burst credits to cover +3 peaks. Offer 20% commitment discount on reserved hours and 10% additional if they prepay 6 months.
Sam: We should also propose an autoscale policy: scale up immediately when queue length > 150 for 60s, scale down if queue < 50 for 10min. Use spot capacity for extra burst where legal.
Priya: Flag: customer requires strict AZ affinity for KMS. We'll need to confirm that Private deployment can meet that or Dedicated in same region with KMS in customer's account.
Maya: Zenith also asked about rollback if quantized model degrades quality. We need canary rollout + auto-fallback to full-precision model if eval regression > 1.5% on their eval set.
Alex: We'll include monitoring: per-route error/latency, token-level cost, and evaluation hooks so their QA can validate outputs during POC.
Maya: Blockers right now: SSO integration timeline (customer wants SAML before POC), legal on DPA, and finalizing reserve count. Sales said SSO is a hard stop.
Priya: I'll reach out to security engineering for an accelerated SAML onboarding (target 3 business days). Adding contact: deploy-bot will post deploy events to #sales.
Sam: Ops question: do we want to recommend prewarming KV cache as part of the POC runbook (yes) and include a simple k6 script for synthetic load? Example snippet:
Sam: ```bash
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 10m ./scripts/zenith_preheat.js
```
Lee: Nice. Also propose a daily KV refresh window during low traffic to maintain warm cache for first 30 minutes of peak.
Maya: Customer follow-up: can they reduce reserved from 3 -> 2 if they take 6 months prepay? Lee to confirm discount thresholds.
Lee: I'll ask finance and get a number. Tentative: 2 GPUs + 4 burst credits = smaller discount; 3 GPUs reserved gets the full 20%.
Priya: I'll attach the questionnaire answers by EOD and flag any missing compliance docs.
Alex: I'll prepare a short runbook doc (one-pager) for the customer with capacity diagrams, autoscale thresholds, and rollback steps.
Maya: Sounds good. New action: schedule a 30m presales sync with Zenith + engineering: when are people free tomorrow 10-2pt?
Sam: I can do 11-1pt.
Lee: 12pt works.
Priya: 11:30pt ok for me.
Maya: Booking 11:30 PT then. I'll DM calendar invite. Thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window for preheat job on staging at 2025-12-03T18:00:00Z. Trigger: @sam
Maya: Marking thread done for now. We'll reopen if SSO/legal stalls.
